# bin

CLI entry points and launcher scripts for local-router and PQC secrets.

## Purpose

- `bin/local-router.js` — primary start/stop/status CLI.
- `bin/localrouter.js` — legacy router script.
- `bin/lib/claude-runner.js` — `claude` shim: applies the Anthropic loopback env when interception is on.
- `bin/lib/codex-runner.js` — `codex` shim: selects the managed `local-router` Codex profile when interception is on.
- `bin/lib/cli-spawn.js` — resolves generated `.cmd` wrappers to their real `.js`/`.exe` target so prompts keep their argv quoting.
- `bin/agents-doctor.js` — cross-platform readiness and `--verify` round-trip check for both harnesses.
- `bin/pqc-doctor.js` — maps PQC secret names to providers, shows unmapped names with the canonical name to pack.
- `bin/pqc-secrets` — PQC secrets dispatcher: native `pqc-secrets.darwin-arm64` on macOS arm64, otherwise the Python (uv) engine at `.agents/skills/pqc-secrets/scripts/pqc_secrets.py`. Both write the same bundle JSON format.
- `bin/fvs-code.js`, `bin/lib/localrouter-client.js` — launcher/client utilities.

## Ownership

- Maintained by local-router team.

## Local Contracts

- Node CLI scripts; keep them POSIX-portable.

## Work Guidance

- Use for user-facing start, stop, status, route-set commands.
- PQC secrets binary must never log key material.

## Verification

- Smoke test `bin/local-router.js status` after deploy.

## Child DOX Index

No child DOX files are required.
